package competency

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

func TestDiscoverTargetsUsesBoundedCanonicalCatalogContract(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path != "/internal/learning-targets/candidates" || request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "planner-token" {
			t.Fatalf("path=%s token=%q", request.URL.Path, request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		var body struct {
			Schema string   `json:"schema"`
			Stacks []string `json:"stacks"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || body.Schema != "learning-target-candidate-request.v1" || len(body.Stacks) != 1 || body.Stacks[0] != "javascript" {
			t.Fatalf("body=%+v err=%v", body, err)
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"learning-target-candidates.v1","targets":[{"ref":{"type":"capability","key":"javascript.dom-events","version":"v1"},"title":"DOM events","description":"Handle browser events","prerequisites":[{"type":"concept","key":"javascript.dom-basics","version":"v1"}]}]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	result, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "planner-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).DiscoverTargets(context.Background(), []string{"javascript"})
	if err != nil || len(result) != 1 || result[0].Ref.Key != "javascript.dom-events" {
		t.Fatalf("result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
	}
}

func TestResolveExactTargetsRejectsIdentityDrift(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "planner-token" {
			t.Fatal("missing internal token")
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"learning-target-resolution.v1","resolved":[{"type":"capability","key":"go.other","version":"v1"}],"missing":[]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "planner-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).ResolveExactTargets(
		context.Background(), []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: "capability", Key: "go.http", Version: "v1"}},
	)
	if err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestResolveExactTargetsAcceptsSameOrderedIdentities(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"learning-target-resolution.v1","resolved":[{"type":"capability","key":"go.http","version":"v1"}],"missing":[]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "planner-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).ResolveExactTargets(
		context.Background(), []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: "capability", Key: "go.http", Version: "v1"}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v", err)
	}
}
